back: Live: brown. Neutral: blue. Earth: green-and-yellow.

front: Why are switches and fuses in the live wire?
back: So that when they open, the appliance is disconnected from the high voltage.

front: How do you choose a fuse?
back: Work out the normal current (I = P/V) and choose the smallest rating above it.
A switch that opens automatically when the current is too large; it can be reset.
A fault makes a large current flow to earth, the fuse melts or the breaker trips, and the case is no longer live.
An insulating outer casing and doubly insulated live parts, so no earth wire is needed; the fuse still protects the cable.
Damaged insulation, overheating cables, damp conditions, overloaded sockets and leads.
Brown to right (via fuse), blue to left, green-and-yellow to top; cable grip on the outer sheath.
